sentences: I reside in a very serene society and all the inhabitants are cordial.
Everybody knows everybody and often we celebrate occasions together.
Seldom there is any dispute and if there is one then it is resolved amicably.
Recently a family came to live in our building and they took the apartment just above ours.
Their younger son, Arun is nearly of my age.
And he is a huge fan of rock music which I could tell from the sound that came from above every evening.
Initially the sound levels were unobtrusive but after a few days the volume grew louder and since he played it till late in the night, it interfered with my sleep.
I thought it might be one off case but when it continued for some days I decided to talk to his parents.
His parents seemed like nice people and assured me that they would talk to their son.
For few days things went back to normal but then he again started playing music loudly.
I again complained to his parents and this time they suggested that I talk to him in person because I might be in a better position to explain my trouble.
Initially I had some apprehensions because for some reason I had construed this image of Arun being a stubborn boy.
I guess that was because of the perception of western rock stars in my mind.
But when I talked to him, he came across as a very jovial person.
As I had guessed rightly, he is diehard fan of rock music and told me that for him rock music is a stress buster.
Lately he had been under stress because of his school tests performance therefore he resorted to his usual relaxing activity.
When I told him that his loud music had been really disturbing for me he sincerely apologized and assured that it will not happen again.
Since then he has not given me a chance to complain and we have become very good friends.
We share some common interests and spend quality time whenever we get time.
Like me Arun too is an avid football fan and his room is full of posters of Messi.
He is the captain of his school football team and a complete all-rounder.
He is also member of his school drama team and frequently writes for his school journal.
He has become an inspiration for me and encouraged me to participate more actively in extra curricular activities in my school as well.
I am glad that I could help him with his school work in which he was facing difficulty.
It has become a sort of tradition now for both of us to meet over the weekend and spend hours together discussing not only sports but academic interests as well
And this practice has helped both of us to improve immensely.

sentences: Every person should have a role model in his life to look up to.
For me that person is my paternal uncle.
He has always loved me like his own son and I cannot even count the number of gifts he has bought me since my childhood.
I too treat him like my father and have always looked for opportunities to show my appreciation for whatever he has done for me.
He is highly respected in our family because of many traits that he possesses but the one quality of his which I admire the most is his magnanimity.
He is always ready to help anyone in need and he would even go out of his way to ensure that the person in distress is relieved from his misery.
I have seen him so many times helping our family members in whatever way possible either financially or emotionally.
He is an active member of many social groups which work towards the betterment of the society.
One such group is an NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.

He told me that this NGO is very close to his heart because he firmly believes that children are the future of a nation and without proper education we cannot ensure a bright future for these children as well as the nation.
So by organizing these classes for the poor children he is contributing to a much larger cause.
That is why I simply admire my uncle.

He not only believes in doing such good deeds himself, he also believes in inculcating such great moral values in the younger generation and I am glad that true to his belief he once gave me an opportunity to make a small contribution in the larger scheme of things.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
So my uncle asked me if I would be willing to take those science sessions for one day, an invite which I gladly accepted.
I went to the camp with my uncle and began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the table.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO is doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.
He promised me that he would arrange something for me in the near future.

sentences: I live in a joint family and my uncle is the oldest member of our family.
He loves me like his own son and is highly respected in our family because of his rational demeanour and the things he has achieved in his life.
My grandfather was not a rich person so my uncle had to work part time jobs to pay for his higher education.
He did engineering from one of the best institutes in our country and got a job in the biggest IT company in India.
After working there for couple of years he did MBA and completely changed his professional line by joining a consulting company.
When I asked him that why did he join a consulting company his answer came as a surprise to me.

He said that he joined consulting company because of his love for travelling and while working in a consulting company he would get ample opportunities to travel across the globe and not only in India and the best part he told me was that company pays for all the traveling expenses so it is like a paid vacation for him.
Being brought up in a lower middle class family he never got the opportunity to fly in a plane but he was always fascinated whenever he saw planes in the sky.
So he told me that by joining the consulting company he gets the opportunity to fulfil his dream of traveling in a plane.
Now he often travels in plane as he makes frequent visits to clients abroad and he tells me that every time he flies it is a new experience for him.
Although now he has flown more times than he can remember he still feels the same thrill when the plane takes off which he felt when he flew for the first time.
Another reason he told he likes flying is the perks he gets for being a frequent flyer with a particular airline.
He has gathered enough points to become the platinum member of the airline through which he travels most often.
He tells me that after gaining the platinum membership he is treated like a VIP on the flight.
He gets to choose this seat and food as per his convenience and gets a lot of complementary things on the flight such as snacks and drinks.
He is a genial person and loves to make new friends and flying gives him ample opportunities to meet new people from different cultures and make new friends.

He tells me that every time he flies he tries to make a conversation with a stranger from another country so that he can learn about their culture and know about places which are worth visiting in his country.
Now he flies at least twice or thrice in a month and he tells me that he living his dream of working while travelling frequently in plane.

sentences: I have an inquisitive nature and I am always eager to learn new things.

Learning new things not only improves our knowledge it also helps us to grow mentally as scientific research has proven that learning new skills keeps our brain young by forming new connections in the brain.
I read an article which said that learning a new language or a musical instrument is extremely beneficial for our intellectual well-being.
I don’t have much interest in musical instruments but there is one particular foreign language that I had wanted to learn.
That language is Spanish.
Driven by my passion to learn this language I started my research on sources which could help me to achieve this dream of mine.
Luckily I found a language school near by my home which is renowned for its foreign language facilities.
This school is run by Mr. Fernandes who is the director over there.
Honestly I went to visit this institute with some apprehensions because there are not many tutors in our area who are renowned to have a good command over Spanish.
But all my apprehensions were laid to rest the moment I met Mr. Fernandes.
He comes across as a very genial person and immediately made me feel at home when I entered his office to discuss my aim of visit.
First of all he asked me the purpose behind learning Spanish and when I told him that I want to learn a foreign language for my intellectual development he was highly impressed.
Though reluctantly I shared my concern about the ability of tutors in his institute to teach Spanish.
He told me that he personally takes Spanish classes because it is an uncommon language among other foreign languages in demand.
I was further reassured when he told me that he had spent more than 10 years in Spain working as an English language trainer.
During those 10 years he had developed great command over Spanish and is considered a luminary in the field of Spanish language coaching in our city.
He asked me if I had any rudimentary knowledge of the language.
I told him to consider me a complete novice and teach me everything from the beginning.
Then he apprised me of his teaching methodology and I was highly impressed by the way the course was designed for a beginner.
The icing on the cake was his manner of speaking.
He is a very soft spoken person and I discerned him very approachable.
I have been taking Spanish classes under the tutelage of Mr. Fernandes for two weeks now and I can easily say that he is the best teacher I have met so far.
It is only because of his teaching methods and personal investment in me that I have made such rapid progress in this Spanish language course.

sentences: Our country is run by bureaucrats and politicians.
These the most important people in our country who make decisions for the welfare of general public.

Although every bureaucrat and politician have his own significance in his department but I think the most important person who oversees the functions of all these people is our honourable Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
He is perceived as a strong-willed leader and strives to make policies which will lead to a better lifestyle of all people of our country.

His special focus is on uplifting the poorer section of the society and ever since he has come into power he has take some monumental decisions which have ensure that all the underprivileged people of our society get the basic amenities which are prerequisite for a decent lifestyle.
Some of his biggest decisions include Jan Dhan Joyana which was aimed at opening bank accounts for all the citizens of India living below poverty line.

Once the accounts were opened the poor people started getting subsidy directly into their bank accounts which earlier was transferred through middlemen and people never really reaped the full benefit of it.
Next he launched a nationwide health scheme in which he provided life insurance of Rupees 5 lac for a premium of just Rupees 12.
This scheme was again aimed at providing health benefits to all the poor people of the country who earlier remained deprived of these facilities because of dearth of money.

He strongly believes that along with people, the environment too needs to be taken care of and is a strong advocate of taking reforms to curb the human activities which are detrimental to the health of the environment.
He has expressed his concern over increasing level of pollution in our cities which is having a grave impact on the health of our citizens.
It was a part of his election manifesto and he promised that if came to power he would do everything in his control to protect our environment.
So far he has delivered on his promise.
Immediately after coming to power he put in measures to check illegal cutting of trees and mining of sand.
He also ordered to impound diesel vehicles which are more than 15 years old.
This legislation was really important as these are the vehicles which damage our environment the most by producing harmful exhausts.
He has been vociferous on the issue of global warming and represented the consortium of developing nations on this matter in the UN.
He was unequivocal in stating that global warming is a real threat and is the direct outcome of human activities which have transpired in the last century.

He further stated that although developed countries have contributed majorly to this problem, it is the responsibility of both developed and developing nations to fight this problem with a concerted effort.
I truly appreciate his efforts to conserve our environment and sincerely hope that we as responsible citizens lend him full support in this endeavour.

sentences: I am a gregarious person and I like to meet new people.
Therefore I always wait for social occasions where I can get opportunities to interact with new people.
There is one more reason I like such occasions and that is the chance I get to flaunt my amazing wardrobe and to click some great photos which I always keep in my phone.
I have got myself clicked on several occasions and some of my photos are really impressive.
But there is one photo which is very close to my heart.
I have got this photo framed and hung it in my room.
It was clicked on one of my friend’s son’s birthday party.
I really like this photo because in this photo there are couple of my school friends as well whom I met after a very long time.
I vividly remember that time and the exact moment when this photo was clicked.
I felt just like our school time when we used to enjoy each other’s company.
Whenever I see that picture I feel nostalgic and wish that the school time had never ended because it was the best time of my life.
But the picture also makes me realize that change is the only constant in nature and things always move on.
I look at my friends in the picture and see how much they have changed over the years.
I my memories they are still those young brash kids who would do reckless things at the drop of the hat but in reality they have grown into responsible persons now.
The photo also reminds me how much I enjoyed the event that brought all of us together.
The whole thing was well planned and executed.
My friend had selected ‘Hotel Paradise’ for the event.
The place was inaugurated recently and had gained huge popularity owing to its variety of cuisines, excellent ambience and exceptional service quality.
I was planning to visit this place and luckily the opportunity presented itself.
I arrived at the party with my other school friends at around 8 pm.
I was reminiscing with my old school friends when my friend announced that celebration is about to begin.
The party began with a short performance from his son and his son’s friends who danced on a popular rhyme.
The performance was simply cute and I wondered at the innocence of those kids, such carefree spirits.
It was reminiscent of my childhood days.

The dance performance was followed by another interesting activity in which my friend displayed that how his son had evolved over the years with the help of a collage of images that he had captured since my nephew’s birth.
Everybody appreciated the effort he had put in to make this collage it was highly impressive.
Once the collage had finished he invited everybody to the centre stage for cake cutting ceremony.
His son blew off the candle on the cake and the arena erupted with applause with everybody wishing him happy birthday.
After that the guests offered the gifts they had brought for him.
I had bought a talking puppy for him since I was aware of his love for dogs.
Shortly after guests started to leave and thanked my friend for such a splendid evening.
I too thoroughly enjoyed the party and wish that every now and then I get such opportunities to meet my old buddies.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveller.
I prefer to visit places that have some historical significance because I am intrigued by the folklores associated with such places.
I have seen nearly all the historically important places in the vicinity of my city but there was one monument which had been sitting on the top of my bucket list for quite some time.
That famous building was Hawa Mahal.
Last month I checked off this place too when my uncle’s family planned to visit it.
He had come to our place on 4 days long vacation and I was excited to hear when he told me a visit to Taj Mahal was part of his itinerary.
We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Jaipur, the city in which Hawa Mahal is situated in 2 hours.
As expected there was a long queue of tourists outside the gates of Hawa Mahal waiting to get inside and get a glimpse of this magnificent structure.
The security checks at the entrance were robust and everybody was getting frisked thoroughly.
Finally we went past security checks and entered an aisle where we were given shoe covers which prevent the floor of the building from getting dirty.
I had heard a lot about the beauty of this monumental structure especially its colourful interior and went there will a lot of expectations.
The moment I laid my eyes on it I was completely enchanted by the view in front of my eyes.
I had never seen anything so beautiful before.
The view was absolutely surreal.
The entire inside of the main building including wall and ceiling were covered with breath-taking paintings.
I had seen many historical monuments but the painstaking manner in which these paintings were done is simply exceptional.
I had never seen such a beautiful and colourful place in my life before.
Everything is just perfect.
The vibrant colours in the paintings give the feeling as if these are real and you can talk to the persons in the paintings.
The two pillars on either side of the main structure stand tall like royal guards and are covered with colourful designs.
There are two small rose gardens on either side of passageway that leads to the main building.
While crossing through that passageway it felt as if the royalties are still residing there.
The main building encompasses the tomb of the king who built this epitome of beauty.

I am still in awe of Hawa Mahal and startled because I cannot fathom that how the workers of that era managed to build such near perfect structure without the help of any technology and mechanical gadgets.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
The biggest contribution of this park in improving our life quality is by improving the quality of air that we breathe.
Our city, like other major cities is highly polluted.
In winters the pollution reaches hazardous levels and severely affects the health of the people of our city.

Everybody knows that the best way to purify air is by planting more trees, so the greenery of this park ensures that the air at least in our society is pure and fresh, and one can feel that freshness early in the morning in this park.
There are several other ways in which this park helps the people of our society to better their lives.
Youngsters and adults frequently come to this park for physical activities.
Children play their usual games such as football, cricket, badminton and adults take their morning and evening walks in this park.
Such activities enables these people to keep fit and healthy.
But the demography that benefits the most from this park is of elderly people who are retired or do not have regular activities to keep themselves busy.
The aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
Even in the evening these senior citizens sit together in the park and share their life experiences and reminisce over joyous moments of their lives.
Overall this park is a great public utility for all the residents of our society.

provenance.rawExcerpt: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.

sentences: My city is known for two things – food and clothes.
The variety in both the categories is just staggering.
And the reasonable prices just add to the attraction for the buyers who comprise not only of local residents but also consumers from other states.
I too often bought clothes from a shop near by my home.
Earlier I did not have a liking for a particular shop but of late I have developed a predilection for a shopping place where I often go with my family and friends.
The place is Alpha shopping mall.
It opened only two months back and has already become a popular place among local residents to hang out.
The biggest advantage of the shopping mall is its central location which makes it easily accessible to all the people of the city.
But for me the main attraction is the options that it provides me.
I am not a brand conscious person but I don’t mind wearing branded clothes either.
I am not willing to pay exorbitant price just to put a brand name on my clothes.
For me there should be a balance between the appearance of a clothing and the price I pay for it.
And that is why I love this place because it gives me that perfect balance.
All the major clothing brands have their outlets in this mall.
Every time I visit these outlets I can easily find some offers running which allow me to make good purchases within my purchasing power.
I might not get the best of the lot but I always get decent clothes at reasonable prices.
I have already gathered a nice collection of clothes, shoes and some accessories, all thanks to the shopping mall.
There is one more reason why I like this mall and that is its food court.
Every time I go there for shopping, I specially reserve extra half an hour for a visit to the food court.
I simply love the place for the options it has which I don’t normally find at local food joints.
I can choose from all the popular cuisines including Indian, Continental, Chinese, Mexican, Mughlai, Italian and many more.
I find this place really refreshing and whenever I am a bit stressed I visit there with my friends.

sentences: A student’s success is predicated on several important factors.

I have also made some friends of my age there and we have formed a sort of study group.
We share everything with each other which we think would help in our studies.

sentences: In my country the population has been growing at a steady rate.
More number of individuals means more facilities required for their survival including housing spaces.
Due to increased demand for residential spaces there has been a significant decline in green areas.
While the cutting down of trees has been indiscriminate, there is one plant which has recently come into great demand and people are actually planting it in their backyard gardens.
The plant is of kiwi fruit.
Few years back not many people had heard of this fruit.
But it suddenly shot to popularity when its medicinal property to fight the disease of dengue was discovered.
Every year during the period of September-october dengue fever spreads to certain parts of my country.
During that period it becomes an epidemic.
This happens because weather in that period is opportune for breeding of mosquitoes.
No doubt government authorities and people take certain precautions as they are well aware of its danger even then the disease spreads to considerable levels.
The most fatal effect of dengue fever is that it leads to a decline in count of white blood cells in the patient’s body which weakens his immune system and makes him vulnerable to serious infections.
This is where kiwi has proved to be highly effective.
It has been scientifically proven that ingestion of kiwi helps the body to generate new white blood cells which strengthens his immune system.
Hence it is a life saver for the patients of dengue.
Whenever someone is diagnosed with dengue the doctor immediately prescribes him to start taking this fruit.
The fruit has other therapeutic effects as well.
It contains high amount of fibre, so it also helps to improve digestive system.
The fruit is very easy to plant and grow that is why it is becoming a household item.

sentences: Education lays the foundation of a decent life for any individual.
It should be a fundamental right for every citizen.
I have been blessed with a family who deeply believes in the importance of education and has made sure that I have the best education possible.
I was an above average student in my school and my favorite subjects were maths and science.
These two subjects are paramount for intellectual growth of an individual as these challenge one’s ability to think and learn.
Maths is particularly important because of the basic practical skills it teaches us such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
These skills help us perform every day basic activities such as planning our family budget, paying for things and services that we buy and many more.
While these basic skills are the cornerstone of any mathematical teaching, there is one particular skill which I found really interesting and useful.
It is the ability to calculate probability.
I was taught about the concept of probability in my elementary school.
Probability as the name suggests is the ability to calculate the likelihood of any event.
It is a highly complex skill to learn as it requires counterintuitive thinking to calculate probability of anything.
But once I learnt this skill I realized how important and useful it is.
If we think logically then every decision we make in our lives is driven by probability.
Our decisions always have choices to make and we should make the best choice for us.
Now how do we decide which choice is best for us.
This decision should be made on the basis of event that is most likely to happen and which is deciphered by using the concept of probability.
For example recently my father decided to buy a car for the family.
We had shortlisted two models from two different manufacturers but could not decide any further.
That is when I used my probability skills to make the final decision.
I gathered some data points about both the models such as service centres of each company, number of cars sold each year, number of accidents these two models were involved in.
Then I used these data points to figure out that which car is more likely to last long with low maintenance cost using the probability method I learnt in school.

sentences: My city is known for two things – food and clothes.
The variety in both the categories is just staggering.
And the reasonable prices just add to the attraction for the buyers who comprise not only of local residents but also consumers from other states.
But there is one particular product that is like the crown jewel of my hometown and has vouchsafed a distinction to our city because of its uniqueness and popularity and that is the bamboo guitar.
My city has a rich tradition in the field of music and has produced many distinguished musicians who were popular not only in India but worldwide.
The production of musical instruments from bamboo was started by a local family of musicians nearly a century ago.
Initially they manufactured the traditional instruments like sitar and flute which are integral part of Indian classical music.

But in the year 1968 one of the young members of that family went to the USA and there he got his first taste of rock music and was completely enthralled by the mesmerizing music coming out of the guitar.
He came back and shared his experience with his family members and suggested that they should start making their own version of bamboo guitar.
Everybody liked the idea and they started to work on it.
Within a year they produced their first version of bamboo guitar.
Initially the fans of rock music rejected it because it was not similar in looks to the conventional guitar and nobody knew what kind of music it would produce.

But when the family showcased their new product in one of musical concerts held in our city with a memorable performance with the guitar, everybody was on their feet and the bamboo guitar became a hot commodity overnight.
After that performance the family and their new invention bamboo guitar became the talk of the town and was gaining fast popularity among the prominent musicians of the country.
Many prominent figures from the musical industry came to visit that family and requested them to do a short performance with the guitar.
All of them were in awe of this new instrument and were simply bewildered that how such a simple looking piece of bamboo could produce such powerful music.

Gradually the word spread about the guitar outside India as well and in 1975 one of the greatest guitarists the world has ever seen Bob Dylan visited our small hometown to personally experience the magic of the instrument which people had been enchanted with.

The event was covered by global media and after the performance Bob Dylan was in tears and hugged the guitarists and that was the day when that simple invention of bamboo guitar became a global attraction.

provenance.rawExcerpt: My city is known for two things – food and clothes.

sentences: I have always been fascinated by technology and the way it has transformed our lives.
I keep abreast of all the latest developments in the field of technology and regularly read science journals and articles.
There is another tradition that I follow religiously and that is to visit the Science Expo that takes place every year in the month of June in my city.

The Expo provides the opportunity to all major IT companies to showcase their latest products which are based on cutting edge technology and for technology buff like me it is the best opportunity to see and experience these astonishing products live.
This year also I visited the expo with the same zeal and enthusiasm.
The moment I entered the arena it felt like a whole new world something from the sets of a sci-fi movie.
I explored the cabins of almost all the companies and were highly impressed by their latest offerings.
But there was one product which caught my imagination at the very first glance.
It was a 5 feet tall robot which was welcoming and greeting the audience in a very traditional way which almost felt human.
It got me intrigued and went to know more about that robot.
The robot was the latest humanoid invented by the company Humans of Future, a renowned name in the field of artificial intelligence.
They handed me the brochure which apprised me of the latest platform the robot was based on and all the major functions that it could perform.
The robot was priced at USD 300 which gave it the tag of the most expensive product in the expo.
But the team explained in detail that why their product commanded such hefty price and why it was worth every penny.
They told me that the robot can do all the basic chores that we do daily in our homes.
It could do dusting, cleaning, washing dishes and clothes and could take out the trash and put in the bin outside our home.
It was equipped with a highly efficient communication system and could understand all the basic instructions from a human.
They told me give it a try so I asked the robot to bring me a glass of water from the nearby water dispenser.
To my surprise it did not only brought me glass of water, it also asked me if I would like a refill after finishing the glass.
I was simply dumbfounded by the level of intelligence the robot possessed.

This was by far the most amazing piece of technology I had ever seen in the expo and it made me realize that artificial intelligence in not arriving rather it has already arrived and the day is not far when it will become a regular part of our lives.

sentences: A student’s success is predicated on several important factors.

sentences: A good schooling lays the foundation of a better life for any student because it is in school where we first learn the basics of everything.
So it is imperative for parents to put their children in the right which can provide the kind of guidance and great academic facilities.
I was lucky enough to start my schooling from one such great school.
My school’s name is St. Stephen’s Convent school and it is considered to the best school in our city.
I joined this school in the first standard and studied their still senior secondary.

The procedure of getting admission into the school is highly competitive and every year thousands of children apply for the admission but only the selected few are admitted as the school is very particular about its image hence they admit only those children whom they deem intellectually fit enough as per the standards of the school.
My parents prepared me well for the admission process and after few rounds of tests I got admission into the school and that was the day when my life changed for better.
The school is divided into three departments as per the classes.
The first department is responsible for classes 1 to 5, the second is responsible for classes 6 to 9 and third one looks after classes 10 to 12.

The first department focuses solely on building the basics of students in all the major subjects specifically science and maths because my school believes in developing scientific temper and groom students as thinker and not crammers of the subjects.
But the most important department is the third one for couple of reasons.
First is that the classes under the purview of this department are board classes.
But the more significant function of this department is to prepare students for their future career choices.
Most of the students in higher secondary are confused about which stream to choose in senior secondary which could pave the way for bright career for them.
This is where this department plays a crucial rule.
The department has separate career councillors who guide the students to choose the right stream as per their interest and more importantly capability.

They do not only council students, they also meet with parents and make them understand that it is never a good idea to push their children to go for a particular stream just because it is a popular choice.

They apprise the parents of the repercussions if they force their children to choose a particular stream which could culminate into a stressful condition for the student if he is not mentally prepared or capable of performing in that stream.

I wish all the schools had such councillors because every year many students make the wrong choices under duress from their parents and we all know the unfortunate and extreme steps they can take afterwards.
I was lucky enough to be guided properly by one of the career councillors and I am extremely happy with the choice I made with his help.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I along with my family were sitting on a bench waiting for the train to arrive.
I was listening to music on my phone when it started ringing.
It was a call from an unknown number.
I picked up the call and on the other side I heard the sound of a man who sounded like a person in his fifties with a very mature voice.
He asked if it was the customer care number of ANZ bank and I told him that he had got the wrong number.
Either he had the wrong information about the customer care number or it was a case of wrong connection.
I said politely that it was a wrong number and was about to disconnect the call when I discerned some panic in his voice.
Just out of curiosity I asked him what had happened.
He told me that he had lost his credit card and is now worried that it might be misused which would result in a substantial financial loss to him.
That is why he was trying to reach the customer care of the bank to get his card blocked immediately.
I told him that he could do it himself from his mobile phone which he was apparently not aware of.
I was not surprised because generally people in his age group are not very tech savvy and use their mobile phones primarily for calling and messaging.
He requested me if I would be kind enough to take him through the process of blocking the card on the mobile phone.
It was an easy process so I thought of helping him out because I knew he could do it if I guided him properly.
So I told him to first install the mobile application of the bank if it was not installed already.
He told me that it was there on his phone, once I knew this, the rest was a matter of few clicks.
Next I told him to open the app and go to security settings.
He did that and asked me for the next step.
Then I told him to look for block/ unblock card options in that settings which he found immediately and knew what to do next because it was quite obvious from the name of the option.
He checked the box against block card option and immediately got an SMS saying that his credit card had been blocked.
He thanked my profusely and told me that I was a life saver.

I told him that it was not that big a favour and then I heard the siren of the train which signalled that our train was arriving at the station so I told him that I had to leave at which moment he again thanked me and wished me best of luck for my life endeavours.

provenance.rawExcerpt: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.

sentences: Last year I completed my senior secondary.
In our education system higher secondary school is really crucial as its outcome decides the future course for any youngster.
It lays the foundation of a bright career.
Keeping this thing in mind I was determined to do well in that year, hence I did my preparation with utmost sincerity.
But there was one exam in which due to some untoward situation I could not do well in the exam because of shortage of time.
I am a very punctual person and on the day of every exam I used to reach 15 minutes before the reporting time.
I vividly remember it was the day of maths exam.
Like all other days I reached examination centre 15 minutes early.
On the entrance gate every student is asked for their entry pass issued by the board and only the students with the valid entry pass were allowed to enter the premises.
When I reached the gate and guard asked for my pass, I put my hands in pocket to get it out.
For first couple of seconds I could not find it so I thought I might be in my bag.
I rummaged through my bag as I was getting jittery.
Then it hit me that I had left my pass at home.
I explained the situation to the guard and pleaded him to enter the examination centre as the exam was about to start in 20 minutes.
But the guard said that his hands were tied by the rules and regulations and could not allow me without the entry pass.
I broke down with tears and had lost it completely when father of one of other candidate gave me some water to drink.
He asked where my house was and then he drove me to my house in his car.
I picked up the entry pass and then we drove back to the examination centre.
The exam had already started and I was half hour late.
I showed my entry pass and then the guard let me in.
I nervously started writing my test.
But because of paucity of time could not attempt the whole exam.
And when the result came as expected I had scored the lowest in maths as compared to other subjects.

sentences: I am a tech savvy person and like to use technology as much as possible.
I have a predilection for technology since it has made our lives so much convenient and we can do so many operations in the comfort of our homes without having to actually move out.
One such facility I use frequently is e banking.
It has been years since I have visited my bank’s branch because I can do basic operations like transferring money or do online shopping using the online banking facility.
But there are some basic operations which can be performed at the branches only and recently I had to visit the branch for one such requirement.
I got an email from my bank that my PAN is not linked with my bank account and I have to link it before the deadline failing which the bank would freeze my account.
The next day I went to the branch to link the PAN with my account.
It was a quite strange and honestly uncomfortable for me since I was not used to visiting bank branch and wait in lines.
I inquired about the process and the executive told me that I have to fill up an update form and provide the photocopy of my PAN and show the original to him.
When I opened my wallet to get my PAN I was disappointed to see that I was not carrying my PAN in my wallet.
I told the executive about the predicament.
He told me to call someone at home and send the photo of PAN on whatsapp.

As soon as I dialled my father’s number and started talking to him, the guard came to me and told me that customers are not allowed to use mobile phones within premises of the bank and if have to make any urgent call I have to move out of the branch and complete my call.
I looked at the executive and he showed me the board which clearly prohibited customers from using cell phones within the bank.
So I told my father and disconnected the call.
Then I moved out of the branch and dialled my father again and asked him to send the picture of my PAN card.
After few minutes he sent me the picture of the PAN card.
I went to nearby photocopy shop and got the photocopy of my PAN card.
Then I went back to the bank and showed the picture of my PAN card and submitted the photocopy along with the form to update.
While I about to leave I asked him that why are we not allowed to use mobile phones in the bank.
He told me that it is a guideline from the central bank of the country and everybody has to abide by it.
He further told me that this policy has been implemented for customers’ safety only.
I thanked him for the information and for his cooperation and left the bank.

sentences: India is country with rich heritage.
Our country’s history is full of folklores and marked by events that changed the course of history.
But no occasion is more momentous than the day we got independence from British.
15 August 1947 is the most important date in the history of India.
This was the day we regained not only our freedom but our identity as well.
The East India Company landed on the shores of India in the 17th century under the pretense of trade with Indian merchants.
What began as a trade soon became an invasion and before anybody could realize India became a colony of Britain.
The East India Company deployed divide and rule policy to undermine the unity of Indian states.
The infighting between Indian states was unduly exploited by the company.
While the princely states were engaged in fighting with each other, the company slowly and gradually gained control over smaller provinces and critical administrative functions of the country.
Once the company monopolized administrative functions it was a matter of time that the whole country became their property.
The company ruled over India for 200 years without any real resistance because they managed to manipulate the rulers of several Indian states for their own benefits.
But in 1857 the mutiny against British rule was ignited by a small yet a highly significant event in the context of India’s fight for freedom.
A small group of traders were forced by the company’s merchants to use bullet covers that were made from animal skin.
Since it was against their religious belief so they were resisted it which led to a skirmish between the traders and British soldiers.
After this event the fight for freedom gained the impetus which it lacked before.
In the following years many prominent leaders emerged and led this movement for freedom.
Like other revolutions, India’s revolution was also marked with some extremely gory events in which many people sacrificed their lives for this cause.
On the other end of the spectrum there were legends like Mahatma Gandhi who believed in the concept of non-violence and fought this was with unwavering faith in this concept.
Finally on 15 August 1947 British agreed to relinquish control over India.
On the eve of this day our first Prime Minister Jawarlal Nehru gave a speech which became a stuff of legends.
Every year we celebrate this day with supreme pride and in the memory of those who laid down their lives for the freedom of the posterity.

provenance.rawExcerpt: India is country with rich heritage.

sentences: I have had several memorable moments in my life.
But there is one occasion which I will always cherish for my entire life and that is when I got 92% marks in my senior secondary exams.
This achievement is special to me for two reasons.
First is the hardships that I went through just before the exam.
Two months before the exams I fractured my left leg and could not go to my coaching classes.
So I did all the study at home on my own and I am glad that my hard work paid off.
And the second reason is the celebration which I had after achieving this feat.
Actually the whole thing was planned by my family and they kept it as a surprise till the last moment.
I was not aware of any such event and they really succeeded to keep this whole event as a secret from me.
My result came out on Wednesday and on Friday my father said that all of us are going for shopping to get some basic stuff for the home.
So we left at around 6:30 pm in the evening and I had no inkling what was to ensue.
I was surprised when our car entered one of most popular restaurants of our city and my father parked the car there and told us to come out of the car.
I was really confused and asked my father that why had we come here and he told me that he had a brief meeting with one of his friends after which they would leave to do their shopping.
So all of us entered the restaurant and followed my father who walked towards a room titled family hall.
That particular moment still flashes in my mind, the moment we entered the room the whole room lit up and for a moment I could not see anything.
Then gradually things started to sink in and I could see all our close relatives, my friends and their parents in the family hall.
All of them were shouting congratulations to me and when I looked at my father I could see the pride in his eyes with a small tear.
Then I realized that this whole event had been planned by my family to celebrate my achievement of scoring 92% marks.
There was a cake as well with a candle in the shape of number 92 on top of it.
All my relatives came to me and congratulated me and told me how proud they were of me.
My friends’ parents also said the same thing to me and said that they were glad that their children had a friend like me to whom they could look up to.
That was the proudest moment of my life and by the look on the faces of my parents I could say that for them as well it was one of the best moments of their lives.
That day I realized the real importance of my family and thanked god for blessing me with such great parents.

sentences: After completing my graduation I had to choose my future career path.
I was presented with two options.
First was to join an accounting company and work for someone else, and second was to join my family business.

Since I had done my graduation in the field of commerce, I was well suited for the accounting job, but I also realized that I can utilize my knowledge to grow my family business which my father had established successfully with years of hard work.
Ours is a business of bags manufacturing.
We make bags primarily for educational institutes including schools, colleges, private coaching academies and universities.
My father started this business when he was 25 years old.
He began his journey as an intern under his uncle who also was in same business.
For the first three years he worked along side his uncle and learnt the intricacies of the bags business.
This was the time when he used to travel a lot to meet prospective clients and to take repeat orders from the existent customers.
This helped him to make important contacts in the industry at every part of the value chain.
Two years later he decided to take the plunge and start his own venture.
Fortunately he had the blessings, support and experience of his uncle by his side.
He set up a small manufacturing unit close to our ancestral home from where he catered to the local industry.
Since then we have established a state wide presence with more than 150 clients.
Now we are aiming to penetrate other states and are in talks with prospective local partners.
Owing to my commerce background I joined the accounts department of my company.
In two years I have managed to bring down the costs which has helped to improve our margins.
My father is conspicuously happy with my determination and I can see that feeling of pride on his face when senior managers talk of my contribution.
I am really glad that I opted to join my family business and I would leave no stone unturned to take this business to new heights.

We are very close to each other and share everything with each other.

sentences: I am a gregarious person and like to meet new people.
I believe interacting with different individuals helps me to grow as a person and gives me a new perspective on several aspects of life.
The best occasions to accomplish this are the social events such as family functions.
I always look forward to invitations to these functions and it is very rare that I let go of these opportunities.
Last week also I got an invite to the birthday party of my nephew.
He is an adorable child and I have always enjoyed his company.
My cousin had selected ‘Hotel Paradise’ for the event.
I arrived at the party with my family at around 8 pm.
The guests had already started coming.
I knew almost everybody present there so it was not tough to strike a conversation.
I was having a chat with an old acquaintance when my cousin announced that celebration is about to begin.
He had planned everything.
The party began with a short performance from my nephew and his friends who danced on a popular rhyme.
The performance was simply cute and kind of funny as their childish dance moves really amused me and at very move I was laughing and admiring their free spirit.
It was reminiscent of my childhood days.
The dance performance was followed by another interesting activity in which my nephew and his friends enacted a scene from a very popular movie of our time.
In the original movie scene the villain kidnaps the heroine and the hero rescues her with the help of his friend.
Needless to say that my nephew played the role of hero.
Everybody knew that reprise was going to be fun but I did not know that the performance would make me laugh like a maniac.
Every time a child repeated a dialogue from the movie with his own additions I laughed like I had never before.
The distortions of the dialogue was just too much funny and innocent at the same time.
On top of that the expressions on the faces of children were making the scene all the more humorous.
By the time the act had ended my stomach was aching because I had been laughing so hard incessantly nearly for half an hour.
After the act my cousin invited everybody to the centre stage for cake cutting ceremony.
My nephew blew off the candle on the cake and the arena erupted with applause with everybody wishing him happy birthday.
After that the guests offered the gifts they had brought for him.
I had bought a talking puppy for him since I was aware of his love for dogs.
Shortly after guests started to leave and thanked my cousin for such a splendid evening.

sentences: I have been blessed with a great family.
Apart from my parents I am also very close to my uncle.
He has always loved me like his own son and I cannot even count the number of gifts he has bought me since my childhood.
I too treat him like my father and have always looked for opportunities to show my appreciation for whatever he has done for me.
He has never asked something of me but recently he approached me for a small favour and I felt obliged to help him.
My uncle is associated with a leading NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
So my uncle asked me if I would be willing to take those science sessions for one day.
Initially I was apprehensive as I did not have any teaching experience but I did not want to disappoint my uncle since this was the first time he asked something of me.
Still I shared my doubt with him and he told me not to worry a lot and promised me that I would love this opportunity.
And he proved to be exactly right.
I began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the plate.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO was doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.
He promised me that he would arrange something for me in the near future.

sentences: Today’s modern life has become very hectic.
But there are sporadic moments when we all get some time for ourselves and I think we should take out some time for ourselves.
These are the times when one can do some introspection or do something he or she really loves to do.
Everybody has his or her way to spend these pleasurable moments.
I like to resort to reading whenever I get free time because reading not only relaxes me it also empowers me to grow intellectually.
Reading on different topics allows me to build an all-round perspective.
Although I like to read on all important topics for a holistic improvement, I particularly enjoy reading philosophy.
I know the general perception about philosophy is that it is a heavy and insipid subject but I find it really interesting and some of the books I have read are really exciting.

Recently when I had a couple of holidays and was absolutely free I picked up a book titled ‘The Daily Stoic’ which I can proudly say that I finished in one sitting and the reason behind this achievement is the content of the books which had me hooked from start to finish.
It is a collection of teachings of several prominent ancient Greek philosopher such as Plato, Aristotle and Socrates.
This book is considered the bible of philosophers.
I found this book exciting because it provides a completely different view on life.
It taught me a way to simplify life which we have otherwise made so complicated with our desires.
There is no human being on this planet whose entire life is a bed of roses.
Everybody has to go through hardships at some stage of his or her life and these are the times when one’s character is tested.
What I have learnt from this book is that during tough times the most important thing is to maintain one’s integrity.
The teachings in this book are not meant for a weak-willed person.
While these teachings are pleasing to read but to inculcate these in your daily life is highly challenging and this challenge is what I find the most exciting.
I know if I am able to implement only few of the instructions given in this book, I would come out as a better and an enlightened human being.
I can easily say that reading this book was the best utilization of my free time on that day.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
But there is one particular day when I really had a great time in the park.
That day I got up real early and decided to have a run in the park.
After running for half an hour I decided to take a break and sat on one of the benches which are set up near the boundaries of the park.
Suddenly I heard a huge roar of so many people.
When I turned towards the direction the sound was coming from I saw a group of elderly people doing some sort of strange thing.
Then I remembered that the aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
So I decided to join that group.
At first they were a bit surprised to see a youngster among them because they were not used to have young children in their group.
When I told them I want to try this therapy they warmly welcomed me and apprised me of the method which they said is a kind of ritual of their group.
I started following their every move and laughed and stopped whenever they did.
An exercise which started just as an experiment ended up being one of the most satisfying experiences of my life.
I never thought that a youngster could enjoy the company of old people so much.
After the routine they invited me to have snacks with them.
While having snacks they shared their life experiences with me which were enlightening to say the least.

They also asked me about my future plans and when I told them that I intend to become an engineer, one of the group members who had retired as an engineer talked to me at length about this field and that discussion dispelled so many doubts which I had previously.

sentences: I am a hyper active person and like to keep myself busy.
I indulge in lot of physical activities because I am a health conscious person.

Every morning I go for a run in a park near by my house and I have a fixed regime to running for at least half an hour because I believe running is the best exercise since it involves every muscle of the body.

While doing my warm up I spotted something on the ground.
At first glance it seemed like a piece of paper but when I approached it and picked it up I realized it was a driving license of some person.
The name written on the license was John and the address mentioned was two blocks away from my home.
I immediately started sympathizing with John because I knew that without driving license I impossible to drive through the city and do your daily activities.
And making a new one is even bigger trouble.
I still remember the pain and struggle I had to go through to get my license.
I first applied for a learning license and then the department gave me 500 page book to prepare for my written exam which I had to clear before taking the drive tests.
In the first attempt I failed in my written examination which was kind of embarrassing for me.

In the second attempt I somehow scraped through the written exam but when it came to the drive test, believe me it is easier to get a tiger to eat grass than satisfy those examiners who sit on the passenger seat in the driving seat.
In the first driving test I did not switch on the turn light while taking a turn, he failed me.
In the second driving test I honked at the turn he failed me.
In the third driving test he again failed me because I pressed the brakes too early according to him.
Finally in the fourth attempt I passed my driving test and got my license and you cannot believe the amount of relief which I felt on that day.
Because of this harrowing experience I was empathizing with John because if he did not get his license back then he too would had to go through this cumbersome process.
Luckily I knew the address and on the next day I went to his place.
I rang the bell and John himself opened the door, I recognized him from the photo on the license.
When I told him about the purpose of my visit he could not thank me enough.
He invited me inside and told that he had already the license stolen in the police station which he would now go and take back his statement.
He seemed like a really nice guy, we chatted for couple of hours and then I left.
Every now and then we see each other and exchange greetings.

sentences: It is commonly said that prevention is better than cure.

When it persisted for few days and decided to get myself checked.
When I explained my symptoms the doctor straight away wrote some tests for my fever as he feared the worst.
Reports came and I was diagnosed with dengue.
Luckily it was caught at a very nascent stage and the doctor started my medication immediately.
I was administered the prescribed medicine for dengue along with glucose drips and appropriate diet.
Everyday I had to take the pills for my fever thrice a day.
Also I was given injections on alternate days to fight the infection which has spread throughout my body.
My medication continued for three weeks after which my condition had improved significantly with no fever and very low levels of infection.
For few more days I was kept under observation.
It was a terrible experience for me physically as well as mentally.
And after going through this I just hope that we all take correct measures to eradicate such diseases from our society.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I along with my family were sitting on a bench waiting for the train to arrive.
Five minutes later a man in his mid 40s came and sat beside me.
He immediately took out his phone and dialed someone.
I did not mean to eavesdrop on his conversation but it caught my attention when he mentioned the words medical, non-medical, IT, computer science and job placement.
I discerned from his conversation that he was talking about career choices for someone, most likely his child or someone close to him.
And I turned out to be right when he further said that his son is not sure which stream to choose for his professional studies.
His conversation lasted for nearly 15 minutes after which he started doing something on his phone.
Since I had some knowledge about this field I thought I might help that person so I broached the topic with him.
First of all I asked about the interests of his son.
He told me about his son’s predilection for technology and accordingly I suggested him that his son should opt for non-medical stream for his higher study.
It was fine as far as his interest was concerned but then he inquired about career choices that his son would have if he chose non-medical.
To be honest he was a bit skeptical about non-medical because he knew few of friends’ sons who did engineering and were hard pressed to find suitable employment opportunities for themselves.
He shared his apprehension with me and I acknowledged the fact that things have changed a lot in recent years.
But I reassured him that if his son chooses the relevant field and performs well then there is no dearth of opportunities.
I then apprised him of the couple of fields of technology which are growing in demand such as nanotechnology and biotechnology.
I was able to dispel his apprehensions to a large extent and he thanked me for my counsel and said that he would suggest his son to choose non-medical.

sentences: Gone are the days when information was confined to libraries and experts only.
Today the whole world is connected and has become an open source all thanks to invention of internet.

I read about established alumni members of each college and where they are placed right now because that gave me inkling about what kind of companies I can approach after completing my course.

I can directly approach these colleges and know about the requirements of admission.

sentences: I have a younger brother named Arun.
He is four years younger to me and wants to take the same educational field as I had.
So I am deeply involved in his studies and keep track of his performances and improvements in all the subjects especially in maths since he finds it particularly challenging.
I also help him outside academics if he is stuck at something.
I remember one such incident.
We were sitting together in our living room and he was working on our computer.
I sensed something was not right because he seemed flustered.
I waited for few minutes to see if things settle down but his frustration level was rising with the time then I decided to intervene.
I asked him what was bothering him.
He told me that he was trying to create a gmail account but was not being able to because of some error.
So I asked him to try it once more in front of me so that I could see what he was trying to do and why was he failing in this endeavor.
The basic information that is required to create a gmail account is your full name, age, country and contact number.
He had filled everything correctly yet google was rejecting his gmail application.
Even I was confounded for a moment because everything seemed right to me at the first glance.
Then I gave it a keen look and realized that both of us had misses a nuance.

As it happened at that time my brother was a minor and for minors gmail had a policy that they could not open a gmail account until they provided contact information of his guardian and got it verified from the guardian.
So I told him to put my gmail id in the guardian’s contact column.
As soon as he did it I got a confirmation email from google.
I opened that email and gave my consent to my brother’s gmail account.
Once Google received my consent, my brother proceeded with the process of opening his own gmail account and this time he succeeded.

He was relieved eventually but I told him that this should teach him a lesson that while doing such things on internet he should be very careful and should be mindful of small details because these seen minor but prove to be very critical as it was in this case.

This year also I visited the expo with the same zeal and enthusiasm but this year I had a specific purpose in mind.

I was looking to buy some gadget that would help my mother in her daily household chores because I knew the pain she goes through everyday to keep all of us happy and satisfied to I wanted to thank her in my own geeky way.
The moment I entered the arena it felt like a whole new world something from the sets of a sci-fi movie.
I explored the cabins of almost all the companies and were highly impressed by their latest offerings.
But there was one product which caught my imagination at the very first glance.
It was a 5 feet tall robot which was welcoming and greeting the audience in a very traditional way which almost felt human.
It got me intrigued and went to know more about that robot.
The robot was the latest humanoid invented by the company Humans of Future, a renowned name in the field of artificial intelligence.
They handed me the brochure which apprised me of the latest platform the robot was based on and all the major functions that it could perform.
The robot was priced at USD 300 which gave it the tag of the most expensive product in the expo.
But the team explained in detail that why their product commanded such hefty price and why it was worth every penny.
They told me that the robot can do all the basic chores that we do daily in our homes.
It could do dusting, cleaning, washing dishes and clothes and could take out the trash and put in the bin outside our home.
And that was the moment when I realized that I have found what I was looking for, I had already made up my mind to buy it but still wanted to know more about it just out of curiosity.
The team further explained that it was equipped with a highly efficient communication system and could understand all the basic instructions from a human.
They told me give it a try so I asked the robot to bring me a glass of water from the nearby water dispenser.
To my surprise it did not only brought me glass of water, it also asked me if I would like a refill after finishing the glass.
I was simply dumbfounded by the level of intelligence the robot possessed.

This was by far the most amazing piece of technology I had ever bought in my life and it made me realize that artificial intelligence in not arriving rather it has already arrived and the day is not far when it will become a regular part of our lives.

When I showed it to my mother her first reaction was that I had gone crazy to buy something so expensive but after explaining her everything and demonstrating the activities the robot could perform my mother got excited and her eyes were filled with tears.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I was really looking forward to this journey because I have always enjoyed traveling in a train especially for long journeys as it gives me opportunity to meet new people and learn from them.
In this journey as well I met a person who came aboard at the Delhi junction.
He seemed like a really nice person and when I told him that we are going to Andaman Islands he said that last year he went to the same place.
He shared his experience and guided me about tourist attractions of the Islands.
He also suggested us about the hotels that we should consider for our accommodation and how to stay away from some of the unscrupulous travel agents who are always looking to hoodwink the tourists.
He travelled with us till Kochi where he alighted the train.
Nearly 5 hours later the train reached its destination from where we left for the Islands.
Andaman is like no other place I have seen in India.
It is an epitome of nature’s creativity, with hills on one side and vast expanse of sea beach on the other.
There is so much greenery and open spaces that I could not believe such a place could exist in this modern urbanized world.
The frenzy of urbanization has not yet touched this part of our nation and there are still tribes present there which are living in their orthodox lifestyle.
I met a few guys from these tribes and was really fascinated with their way of living.
I also learnt about a few of their traditions which we would find absurd but are an integral part of their existence.
Their diet is also absolutely different from what we normally have in our daily lives.
Their diet primarily consists of sea creatures, some of which I cannot even imagine to ingest.
I was really enthralled by this visit as I got to see a completely different facet of mankind and nature.
It was a whole new experience for me, something I would remember till my last breath.

sentences: Technology has made our lives as comfortable as ever.
We can achieve nearly anything while sitting in the comfort of our living room.
Everything is available online and can be delivered at our doorstep.
Ecommerce websites have the biggest role to play in this convenience.
I am also a patron of couple of ecommerce sites from where I frequently order things which I require.
I am amazed at the plethora of their catalogue.
Everything, from books to electronic gadgets are available on these sites and are delivered hassle free at our homes.
So far my experience with these sites have been very satisfactory.
But recently I underwent a harrowing incident by making a purchase from one of the biggest ecommerce sites in our country.
I had been planning to buy a new smartphone for quite a while so I searched it on the website and after reading plenty of positive reviews I ordered this phone.
While making the purchase I particularly checked the return policy for this product and the website mentioned that it was returnable within 10 days of the purchase.
As usual the delivery was fast and smooth, I received the phone two days after placing the order.
For first couple of days I was happy with the phone as it was performing better than my expectation.
But on the third day it started getting really hot after playing any video for just ten minutes.
I thought it might be a one off case so ignored it initially.
But the issue persisted and I checked for it online.
A blog had mentioned that this issue was common with this model.
So I called the customer care of the website from where I bought this phone and told them that I want to return this phone as it had a major flaw.
To my surprise the customer care executive told me that I cannot return the phone but they can replace it with new handset.

But that was not going solve my problem because the issue was with all handsets of that particular model so I asked the customer care executive that why I could not return it especially if there website mentioned that the model was returnable within 10 days.
In reply he told me that because of the heating issue they are inundated with return request hence they had changed their policy from return to replace for this model.

I was utterly gutted by his response and felt completely cheated because the policy on which my decision to buy this phone was predicated was altered without any intimation and it had grave consequences for me as I had been delivered a below par product.

I argued with the executive and expounded my situation that it was unfair on their part to change the policy without informing the customers who had bought that product but he said that his hands were tied and he was unable to help me in this regard.
Subsequently I send some emails to the company as well but did not get any helpful revert.
Consequently I was stuck with that faulty phone.
After this terrible experience I decided never to buy any product from that website and also wrote a scathing feedback on their social media platform.

provenance.rawExcerpt: Technology has made our lives as comfortable as ever.
